entities.summary: William Patrick Callahan, OFM Conv. is an American Catholic prelate serving as Bishop of La Crosse from 2010 to May 2024. He is a member of the Conventual Franciscans. William P. Callahan was a religious figures from Chicago (b. 1950-06-17, Chicago). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
